y-m-46-09.title: Kana ma diagonals ari perpendicular, ndi rhombus here?
y-m-46-09.topic: Kutonga chimiro che quadrilateral uchishandisa ma coordinates
y-m-46-09.goal: Tsimbisa nema coordinates kuti ruzivo rwekuti ma diagonals ari perpendicular harukwani kutaura kuti ndi rhombus, rongedza kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwunodiwa kuti ive rhombus, uye ugadzire rhombus iwe pachako.
y-m-46-09.material: Pa coordinate plane pane mapoinzi mana A(0, 0), B(3, 2), C(0, 8), D(−1, 2). Quadrilateral ABCD inobatanidza A, B, C, D nenhevedzano iyoyo. Diagonal AC iri pa y-axis uye diagonal BD iri pamutsara y = 2, saka ma diagonals maviri ari perpendicular. 하은 akati, "Ma diagonals maviri ari perpendicular, saka ABCD ndi rhombus!"
y-m-46-09.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako chimiro chinogutsa mamiriro
y-m-46-09.prereq.1: Mwero pakati pemapoinzi maviri nema coordinates epoinzi yepakati
y-m-46-09.s.s1.prompt: Kutonga kwakarurama nezve chirevo chaHaeun 하은 ndekupi?
y-m-46-09.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga ma squares ekureba kwemativi mana uchishandisa ma coordinates uye uanyore padivi pemumwe.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisawo kana mapoinzi epakati ema diagonals maviri ari poinzi imwe chete.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.o.a: Ndi rhombus. Kana ma diagonals ari perpendicular, mativi ose mana akaenzana pakureba.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.r.a: Si quadrilateral dzose dzine ma diagonals perpendicular dziri rhombus. Tsvaga kureba kwemativi mana zvakananga uchishandisa ma coordinates.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.o.b: Hatigoni kuziva kana ndi rhombus. Tinoda kureba kwema diagonals zvakawanda.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.r.b: Ma coordinates ose akapiwa, saka unogona kutsvaga kureba kwemativi zvakananga. Iyi haisi nyaya apo ruzivo rusina kukwana uye hazvigoni kutongwa.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.o.c: Haisi rhombus. Kureba kwemativi AB ne DA kwakasiyana.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.r.c: Wakatsvaga uye wakaenzanisa kureba kwemativi zvakananga kubva kuma coordinates. AB² = 13 ne DA² = 5.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.o.d: Ndi rhombus. Ma diagonals maviri ane kureba kwakasiyana uye ari perpendicular.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.r.d: Ma diagonals kusiyana uye kuva perpendicular oga hazvitauri kana mativi mana akaenzana.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.explain: AB² = 3² + 2² = 13, BC² = 3² + 6² = 45, CD² = 1² + 6² = 37, DA² = 1² + 2² = 5, saka kureba kwemativi ose kwakasiyana. Kunyange kana ma diagonals ari perpendicular, pane ma quadrilaterals asiri ma rhombus.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvimedu zvose zveruzivo zvinoita kuti, kana zvawedzerwa kuruzivo rwekuti ma diagonals ari perpendicular, ugone kupedzisa kuti 'ndi rhombus'.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.hint.0: Chengeta A(0, 0), C(0, 8) sezvazviri, famisa B ne D pamutsara y = 2, uye utsvage quadrilateral inogutsa imwe neimwe mamiriro asi isiri rhombus.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti mamiriro ekuti mapoinzi epakati akaenzana anovimbisa chii.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.o.a: Diagonal imwe ine kureba kwakaenzana ne2 nguva neimwe diagonal
y-m-46-09.s.s2.r.a: Ratio yekureba kwema diagonals haina hukama hwakananga nekuti mativi mana akaenzana here. Pane chimiro che kite chinogutsa mamiriro iwayo asi chisiri rhombus.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.o.b: Ma diagonals maviri anosangana pamapoinzi epakati eumwe neumwe
y-m-46-09.s.s2.r.b: Kana ma diagonals achigovana nepakati ndi parallelogram, uye unogona kufunga kuti inova quadrilateral ipi kana perpendicularity yawedzerwa.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.o.c: Poinzi yepakati ye diagonal BD iri pa diagonal AC
y-m-46-09.s.s2.r.c: Mamiriro aya anoshandawo kuchimiro che kite. Poinzi yepakati kuva pa diagonal yakasiyana nema diagonals anogovana nepakati.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.r.d: Iyi ingori tsananguro ye rhombus. Funga kana inofukidzana neruzivo rwawatove naro.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.r.e: Ruzivo rwekuti kona imwe haisi right angle runotaura hapana pamusoro pekureba kwemativi.
y-m-46-09.s.s2.explain: Ma diagonals maviri anosangana pamapoinzi epakati eumwe neumwe anoita parallelogram, uye kuwedzera perpendicularity kunoita kuti mativi maviri akavakidzana akaenzana pakureba, saka inova rhombus. Kana mativi ose mana akaenzana pakureba, ndi rhombus netsananguro. Mamiriro asara ose anogutswa ne kite shapes (dzisiri rhombus) senge A(0, 0), B(2, 2), C(0, 8), D(−2, 2), saka haavimbisi mhedziso.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise ma coordinates matatu akasiyana (p, q) e D kuti quadrilateral ABCD ine A(0, 0), B(5, 0), D(p, q) (q > 0), C(5 + p, q) ive rhombus.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga watarisa kana DC yakafanana ne AB uye ine kureba kwakafanana.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti chii chinofanira kuenzana kumativi akavakidzana AB ne AD kuti ive rhombus.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.ok.c1: Poinzi D iri pamusoro pe x-axis.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.fail.c1: q inofanira kuva hombe kupfuura 0. Kana q = 0, mapoinzi mana ari pamutsara mumwe.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.ok.c2: Kureba kwedivi AD ndi5, zvakafanana ne AB.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.fail.c2: Kureba kwe AD hakuenzani ne AB = 5. Mativi maviri akavakidzana anofanira kuenzana kuti ive rhombus.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.explain: Kana D(p, q), C(5 + p, q), saka DC = AB (kureba kwakafanana, parallel), saka ndi parallelogram, uye kana AD = AB = 5, mativi maviri akavakidzana akaenzana, saka ndi rhombus. Saka D ine p² + q² = 25, q > 0 ndiyo mhinduro. Pane (3, 4), (4, 3), (0, 5), (−3, 4), (−4, 3), nezvimwewo.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.because.prompt: Gadzirisa D imwe yawakasarudza uye unyore mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti nei ABCD ichiva rhombus.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.because.hint.0: Nyora kureba kwe AD uchishandisa ma coordinates e D yawakasarudza.

y-m-46-09.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa here kuva parallelogram nekuti mativi maviri akavakidzana akaenzana?
y-m-46-09.s.s3.because.model.0: Kana D iri (3, 4), C iri (8, 4), uye DC yakaenzana uye parallel ne AB, saka ndi parallelogram. AD = √(9 + 16) = 5, yakaenzana ne AB = 5, saka ndi parallelogram ine mativi maviri akavakidzana akaenzana pakureba, saka ndi rhombus.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.because.model.1: Kana D iri (0, 5) uye C iri (5, 5), kutsvaga mativi mana kunopa AB = 5, BC = 5, CD = 5, DA = 5, ose akaenzana, saka ndi rhombus.

y-m-46-02.goal: Gadzira madenderedzwa anopfuura napamapoinzi maviri iwe pachako kuti usimbise kuti ari akawanda, uye utonge kuti mamiriro ekuwedzera api anosarudza denderedzwa kuva rimwe chete (kana kuti hasarudze, kana kuita kuti risavepo zvachose).
y-m-46-02.material: Pacoordinate plane pane mapoinzi maviri A(0, 0), B(0, 8). Funga madenderedzwa anopfuura napo A ne B zvose. Pakati pedenderedzwa ndi (a, b) uye radius ndi r (r > 0). Denderedzwa rinopfuura papoinzi rinoreva kuti chinhambwe kubva papoinzi iyoyo kuenda pakati ndi r. (A inoverengwa 'A' uye B inoverengwa 'B'.)

y-m-46-02.prereq.2: Kunyora chinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri nemacoordinate
y-m-46-02.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira madenderedzwa matatu anopfuura napo A ne B zvose, rimwe nerimwe rine pakati pakasiyana. Isa pakati (a, b) neradius r. Kana radius isiri rational, unogona kuisa dhesimali rinenge.
y-m-46-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pakati panofanira kuva panhambwe imwe kubva ku A ne B. Ratidza pakati pakasarudzwa maviri kana matatu uye utarise kuti ari pamutsetse upi.
y-m-46-02.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzirisa x-coordinate a yepakati pakukosha kwakareruka se 0 kana 3, uye utsvage b ne r dzinosangana namamiriro ose mbiri ka A ne B. Kana r isiri rational, unogona kuiverenga nedhesimali.

y-m-46-02.s.s1.fail.c3: Chinhambwe kubva pakati (a, b) kuenda ku B(0, 8) hachisi r.
y-m-46-02.s.s1.explain: Mumienzaniso yose mitatu b ndi 4. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti mapoinzi ari panhambwe imwe kubva ku A ne B ari pamutsetse y = 4. Unogona kusarudza a zvakasununguka, uye r² = a² + 16 inosarudzwa.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mamiriro ose, kana rimwe rikawedzerwa kumadenderedzwa anopfuura napo A ne B, anosarudza denderedzwa rimwe chete chaiyo.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.hint.0: Uchishandisa mutemo wenzvimbo yepakati wawakawana pa s1, gadzira chirevo che a kumamiriro ega ega uye uverenge kuti pane mhinduro dzingani.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga warongedza kuti mamiriro api anopa mhinduro mbiri kana asina chose.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.r.a: Neradius 5 pakati panogona kuva panzvimbo mbiri, (3, 4) ne (−3, 4). Kunyange mamiriro akawedzerwa, verenga kuti vasarudzwa vangani vanosara.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.r.b: Iyi ndiyo nzira yokuona kuti vasarudzwa vangani vanosara kana ukashandisa pamwe chete chokwadi chokuti pakati ari pa y = 4 nemamiriro okuti ari pa y = x.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.r.c: Pakati panofanira kuva pa y = 4, asi izvo hazvisangani neaxis ye x (y = 0). Mamiriro akawanda haareve kuti denderedzwa riripo. Hapana denderedzwa rakadaro zvachose.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.r.d: Iyi ndiyo nzira yokuverenga nechirevo kana mamiriro okupfuura papoinzi imwe yakawedzerwa anosarudza a kuva kukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.r.e: Iyi ndiyo nzira yokuona kana mamiriro okubata anova chirevo pakati pe r ne b chinosarudza a.
y-m-46-02.s.s2.explain: Pakati pane chimiro (a, 4) uye r² = a² + 16. Kana ari pa y = x saka a = 4 (imwe), kana rinopfuura papoinzi (6, 4) saka kubva pa a² + 16 = (6 − a)² tinowana a = 5/3 (imwe), uye kana rinobata aksi ye x saka r = 4 saka a = 0 (imwe). y-m-46-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mamiriro ekuwedzera ako pachako anoita kuti denderedzwa rinopfuura napo A ne B risarudzwe kuva rimwe chete chaiyo. Tsanangurawo kuti mamiriro iwayo anobatana sei ne y-coordinate yepakati kuti denderedzwa rinosarudzwa kuva rimwe chete.

y-m-46-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti mamiriro ako haasi nyaya ine madenderedzwa maviri kana asina chose?
y-m-46-02.s.s3.model.0: Mamiriro ekuwedzera: radius ndi 4. Pakati panhambwe imwe kubva ku A ne B, saka y-coordinate yayo ndi 4 uye ine chimiro (a, 4). Kuisa r = 4 muna r² = a² + 16 kunopa a = 0 chete, saka denderedzwa rinosarudzwa kuva rimwe chete chaiyo.

y-m-46-04.topic: Locus yemapoinzi ane reshiyo yezvinhambwe yakagadzikana
y-m-46-04.goal: Paradzanisa kuti unogona kuenda kure zvakadini nehumbowo hwemapoinzi mashoma, tsvaga mapoinzi akawanda anosangana namamiriro kuti ufungidzire chimiro che locus, uye utaure maitiro anodikanwa kuti usimbise.
y-m-46-04.material:
Pacoordinate plane pane mapoinzi maviri A(−2, 0), B(4, 0), uye poinzi P inosangana na PB = 2 × PA. (PA ndicho chinhambwe kubva papoinzi P kuenda ku A.) 민호 akati: "Kana PA = PB, saka P iri pamutsetse wakananga unoparadzanisa chikamu AB pakati (mutsetse). Kana reshiyo iri 1 : 2, ma P iwayo achavawo pamutsetse mumwe." Kutarisa chirevo che 민호, mapoinzi mana anosangana na PB = 2 PA akaongororwa.
Poinzi | PA | PB | PB = 2PA
P1(0, 0) | 2 | 4 | yakasangana
P2(−8, 0) | 6 | 12 | yakasangana
P3(−4, 4) | √20 | √80 | yakasangana
P4(−4, −4) | √20 | √80 | yakasangana
(√20 inoverengwa 'root makumi maviri'.)
y-m-46-04.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako mapoinzi anosangana namamiriro
y-m-46-04.s.s1.prompt: Kubva pamapoinzi mana ari patafura, tinogona kutaura chii zvirokwazvo pamusoro pechirevo che 민호?
y-m-46-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ratidza zvakareruka mapoinzi mana etafura pacoordinate plane uye uenzanise kuti ari kupi.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa slope kuti uone kana mapoinzi matatu P1, P2, P3 angava pamutsetse mumwe.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.o.a: Mapoinzi ose mana anosangana namamiriro, saka Minho akarurama.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.r.a: Kuti pane mapoinzi anosangana namamiriro hakufanani nokuti mapoinzi iwayo ari pamutsetse mumwe. Enzanisa nzvimbo dzemapoinzi mana.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.o.b: Chimiro chinodhirowa nemapoinzi mana idenderedzwa, saka locus idenderedzwa.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange mapoinzi mana ari padenderedzwa rimwe, hakuna chivimbiso chokuti mapoinzi ose anosangana namamiriro ari pandenderedzwa iroro.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.o.c: Mapoinzi mana haasi pamutsetse mumwe, saka chirevo chaMinho hachishande.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.r.c: Kuti mapoinzi chaiwo anosangana namamiriro haasi pamutsetse mumwe muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.o.d: Pane mapoinzi mana chete, saka hatigoni kutaura chinhu pamusoro pokuti chirevo che 민호 chakarurama kana chakanganisa.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.r.d: Zvakaoma kusarudza kuti chakarurama, asi kuti chakanganisa kunogona kurongwa nomuenzaniso mumwe unopikisa.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.explain: P1 ne P2 ziri paaxis ye x uye P3 haisi paaxis ye x, saka mapoinzi mana haasi pamutsetse mumwe. Mapoinzi aya ose mapoinzi chaiwo anosangana namamiriro, saka chirevo che 'P yega yega iri pamutsetse mumwe' chakanganisa. Asi, nemapoinzi mana aya oga haugoni kusarudza kuti 'locus idenderedzwa'.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise mapoinzi 3 akasiyana P(x, y) anosangana na PB = 2 PA uye asiri patafura. (Unogona kunyora macoordinate kusvika padhesimali rimwe. Tinobvuma kana musiyano pakati pa PB ne 2PA uri mukati me 0.25 nokuda kwokuverenga.)
y-m-46-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ratidza mapoinzi etafura pacoordinate plane kuti utarise chimiro, wobva wasarudza mapoinzi matsva anotevera chimiro icho uye uyedze PB = 2PA.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza x-coordinate kusvika padhesimali rimwe, fungidzira nekashandisi kuverenga y inopa PB = 2PA, wobva waenzanisa zvinhambwe zvakananga.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Musiyano pakati pa PB ne 2PA mukuru. Verenga zvakananga zvinhambwe kubva papoinzi kuenda ku A ne B uye uzvienzanise.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Ipoinzi yatovapo patafura kana iri padhuze zvakanyanya.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.explain: (−1.6, 3.2), (−6.4, −3.2), (−0.8, 2.4) dzose dzinosangana na PB = 2PA. Zvakanaka kana wakacherechedza kuti mapoinzi aya nemapoinzi mana etafura ari ose padenderedzwa rine pakati (−4, 0) neradius 4.

Tinofanira kuisa P(x, y), kuwanza mativi ose maviri ePB = 2PA kaviri, kuwedzera nekupfupisa, uye kuongorora kana equation inobuda iri equation yedenderedzwa.
y-m-46-04.s.s3.model.1: Pane mapoinzi mashoma chete, saka kwakamira kugadzirisa. Kumapoinzi ose P tinofanira kunyora PB² = 4PA² semuequation mu x, y uye kuipfupisa kuona kana ichiva (x + 4)² + y² = 16, uye zvakapesana tinoongorora kana poinzi yega yega padenderedzwa iri ichiita mamiriro.
y-m-46-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro yemuenzaniso inotaura nzira dzose mbiri
y-m-46-04.s.s3.model.2: Mapoinzi ari mutebhura imwe chete yemapoinzi, saka hatigoni kusimbisa kuti idenderedzwa. Tinofanira kugadzira equation nekuipfupisa, uye tiongororewo mamwe mapoinzi ari padenderedzwa.

y-m-46-10.material: Denderedzwa C: (x − 1)² + (y − 2)² = 4 rine pakati (1, 2) ne radius 2. Funga kufamba kuviri. T(a, b): famisa poinzi imwe neimwe ne a kuenda kudivi re x uye ne b kuenda kudivi re y. S: reflect mumutsara y = x. (Poinzi (p, q) inofamiswa kuenda ku (q, p).) "T wozoita S" zvinoreva kuita T kutanga wozoita S pamhedzisiro, uye "S wozoita T" zvinoreva kuita S kutanga wozoita T pamhedzisiro. Denderedzwa rinochengeta radius yaro kana rafamiswa, saka unongoda kutevera nzvimbo yepakati. ((x − 1)² inoverengwa "x minus 1, squared," uye y = x inoverengwa "y equals x.")
y-m-46-10.prereq.2: Reflection pamusoro pe x-axis (x, y) → (x, −y) ne equation yedenderedzwa
y-m-46-10.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe nyaya painoratidzwa, sarudza kutonga kwekuti mhedzisiro yekurongeka kuviri ('T wozoita S', 'S wozoita T') yakafanana here.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.hint.0: Tevera pakati pamwe chete (1, 2) uye unyore ma coordinates padanho rega rega.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.hint.1: Mutafura, boka mitsara yakafanana nemitsara yakasiyana, uye utsvage zvavanofanana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Takaedza T(3, 3). "T wozoita S": pakati (1, 2) → (4, 5) → (5, 4). "S wozoita T": pakati (1, 2) → (2, 1) → (5, 4). Mhedzisiro yekurongeka kuviri yakafanana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kuona nyaya iyi, ndekupi kufunga kwako zvino nezve kuti mhedzisiro yekurongeka kuviri yakafanana here?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Kune T(3, 3), mhedzisiro yekurongeka kuviri yakafanana. Asi pane nyaya imwe chete, saka hatigoni kuziva kana izvi zvakarurama kune T dzimwe zvakare.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kana kurongeka kukachinjwa, mhedzisiro inogara yakasiyana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Munyaya yawakangoona, dzakanga dzakafanana. Chirevo ichi hachisangani nenyaya.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Chero kufamba T kupi, mhedzisiro yekurongeka kuviri inogara yakafanana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Pane nyaya imwe chete. Haugoni kupedzisa "inogara" kubva panyaya imwe. Unofanira kuedza T dzimwezve.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Unofanira kutevera kwaunoenda pakati, kwete chimiro chedenderedzwa.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Dzakafanana munyaya iyi. Tinofanira kuedza zvakawanda kuti tizive kana dzakafananawo kune T dzimwe.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Iyi hunhu hwekufunga kuti chakafanana munyaya imwe chete chinogona kuwedzerwa kunyaya yakajairika here.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Takaedza T(3, 0). "T wozoita S": pakati (1, 2) → (4, 2) → (2, 4). "S wozoita T": pakati (1, 2) → (2, 1) → (5, 1). Mhedzisiro mbiri dzakasiyana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kuona nyaya iyi, uchaitei nekufunga kwako kwekutanga?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Pakati pe "T wozoita S" ndi (2, 4) uye pakati pe "S wozoita T" ndi (5, 1), saka madenderedzwa akasiyana. Muenzaniso unopikisa waonekwa, saka chirevo che "dzinogara dzakafanana" hachishande.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Nyaya iyi yakasiyana, saka ndinochengeta kufunga kwangu kwekutanga sezvakaita.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kufunga kwe 'dzinogara dzakafanana' kunoputswa nemuenzaniso mumwe unopikisa. Tarisazve kuverenga kwenyaya iyi.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Rasa kufunga kwe 'dzinogara dzakafanana' uye uone kuti zvinosiyana zvichienderana ne T.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakarasa 'inogara' nekuda kwemuenzaniso mumwe unopikisa uye wakarongedza kuti zvinosiyana zvichienderana nemamiriro.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kuverenga kunofanira kuva kwakashata. Inofanira kupa mhedzisiro imwe chete.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Mapakati maviri anobuda akasiyana, (2, 4) ne (5, 1). Dzokorora kuverenga kuviri iwe pachako.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Saizi yedenderedzwa inochinja panzvimbo yenzvimbo yepakati, saka haigoni kuenzaniswa.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Translation ne reflection hazvichinji radius yedenderedzwa.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.info:
Takazvironga ne T dzakawanda.
(a, b) | pakati pe T wozoita S | pakati pe S wozoita T | zvakafanana?
(3, 3) | (5, 4) | (5, 4) | zvakafanana
(3, 0) | (2, 4) | (5, 1) | zvakasiyana
(−2, −2) | (0, −1) | (0, −1) | zvakafanana
(2, −5) | (−3, 3) | (4, −4) | zvakasiyana
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mamiriro akakodzera pa (a, b) ekuti mhedzisiro yekurongeka kuviri yakafanana ndeapi?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Mu "T wozoita S" pakati ndi (2 + b, 1 + a), uye mu "S wozoita T" ndi (2 + a, 1 + b), saka zvakafanana chete kana 2 + b = 2 + a, ndiko kuti, kana a = b. Sezvo S inotsiva x-coordinate ne y-coordinate, kana T ikaitwa kutanga, huwandu hwe translation a ne b hunotsiviwawo.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kana a = 0 chete (b inogona kuva chero kukosha)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mu (3, 3) ne (−2, −2), a haisi 0 asi mhedzisiro yaiva yakafanana. Tarisa kuti mitsara yakafanana mutafura ine kukosha kupi kunofanana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kana a = −b chete (kana a ne b dziine zviratidzo zvakapesana)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Mumitsara yakafanana yetafura, zviratidzo zve a ne b zvakafanana. Tsvaga zvinofanana mitsara yakafanana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kana a = b chete (kana mwero miviri yekufamba yakaenzana)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Mitsara yakafanana ine a = b, uye mitsara yakasiyana ine a ≠ b. Kana ukatevera ma coordinates epakati, ndiyo mamiriro ekuti 2 + b ne 2 + a dzienzane, uye 1 + a ne 1 + b dzienzane.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.reflect: Munyaya yekutanga (3, 3), mhinduro yaiva "zvakafanana," uye ipapo munyaya yechipiri "zvakasiyana" yakabuda. Tarisazve kuti chii chaiva nenjodzi mukupfuvura kubva panyaya imwe apo dzaiva dzakafanana, uye kuti mitsara yakafanana nemitsara yakasiyana yetafura inofanana sei.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei mhedzisiro yekurongeka kuviri dzichisiyana kana a ≠ b, nekutsanangura kuti ma coordinates epakati (1, 2) anofamba sei.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kune kurongeka kumwe nekumwe, nyora x-coordinate ne y-coordinate yepakati, mutsara mumwe imwe neimwe.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa, kurongeka nekurongeka, kuti reflection S inokanganisa sei huwandu hwe translation a ne b.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora uchisiyanisa kana mabasa e translation amounts a ne b akatsiviwa kana kusatsiviwa pakupfuura nereflection here?
y-m-46-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakafungawo here kuti nei pasina musiyano kana a = b?
y-m-46-10.s.s2.model.0: Kana T ikaitwa kutanga, pakati panova (1 + a, 2 + b), uye sezvo S inotsiva x-coordinate ne y-coordinate, inova (2 + b, 1 + a). Kana S ikaitwa kutanga, inova (2, 1), uye ipapo ne T inova (2 + a, 1 + b). Saka kana a ≠ b, ma x-coordinates 2 + b ne 2 + a anosiyana, saka mhedzisiro dzinosiyana.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.model.1: S inotsiva x-coordinate ne y-coordinate, saka kana translation yaitwa kutanga, huwandu hwe translation a ne b hunotsiviwawo, uye zvakafanana nekuti pakati pafamba nechakatwasuka ne b uye nechakamira ne a. Kana S yaitwa kutanga, inofamba nechakatwasuka ne a uye nechakamira ne b. Saka kana a ne b dzakasiyana, mhedzisiro inoenderana nekurongeka.
